authenticity_review: The image exhibits high visual fidelity with excellent texture rendering on the bagel (glossy crust, sesame seeds) and pig fur. However, structural artifacts are present in the lower limbs: the hooves of the middle and right pigs lack distinct cloven definition and appear slightly fused or melted into the straw/ground interface. The animal pose auditor flagged HIGH risk (82% low-confidence keypoints), corroborating these anatomical imperfections. Additionally, the scale of the bagel relative to the piglets is physically unrealistic (bagel is nearly as tall as the pigs), though this may be an artistic choice rather than a generation failure. Overall quality is high but not flawless due to limb grounding issues.
key_defects: Hoof definition lacks distinct cloven separation; feet appear partially fused with straw/ground.
Bagel scale is disproportionately large relative to piglets (physical implausibility).
